title: We built a game that teaches kids how to share a river.
author: kouklimou
selftext:
There is one river and five who need it: a farm, a factory, a power station, a town, and the fishes.   
  
Since there is never enough for everybody, the goal is to manage the river and split it drop by drop amongst the different stakeholders. Each decision has consequences and you have to survive for 3 years.  
  
You can also throw a water balloon battle. It scores nothing but it's worth it.   
  
Soon available inside the Marble beta, alongside plenty more interactive learning experiences for kids aged 6 to 12.  
  
Link to play River Keeper web demo: [https://withmarble.com/river-keeper/](https://withmarble.com/river-keeper/)
